name: RomM
description: Beautiful ROM manager and web emulator: scans your retro game library, pulls metadata and covers, and plays directly in the browser.
compose:
services:
  romm:
    image: zurdi15/romm:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8080"
    environment:
      ROMM_DB_DRIVER: "sqlite"
    volumes:
      - ${{cfg.library_dir}}:/romm/library
      - ./data:/romm/resources
    restart: unless-stopped
